moves.name: Spike Spit
moves.notes: Always followed by Whirl. This move first loses 2 Thorns , then attacks three times. It is always followed by "Whirl".

moves.name: Whirl
moves.notes: Always followed by Spiken. Always used at the start of combat. If Toadpole is not in front, it starts with this move. In the normal loop, this follows "Spike Spit".

moves.name: Spiken
moves.notes: Always followed by Spike Spit. Always used at the start of combat. If Toadpole is in front, it starts with this move. This gains 2 Thorns , then is always followed by "Spike Spit".

enemy.pattern_text: Shows this enemy's repeating move order.
enemy.review_reason: Multiple moves flagged as combat-openers: ['Whirl', 'Spiken'] -- likely position-dependent (e.g. front/middle/back in a pack); needs manual disambiguation.
